ambiguity: Completely interchangeable with the other two female figure silhouettes in this group; at very small sizes, the triangular body on a rectangular base can resemble an upward arrow beneath a dot or a simplified evergreen tree.

reasoning: The icon is the universal restroom-style pictogram of a standing female figure in a triangular dress. It works well for tasks centered on a female family member (mom, daughter, grandmother, sister), women's health appointments, or women's organizations, though at tiny sizes the triangular torso on a narrow base can momentarily look like an evergreen tree or an upward arrow with a dot.
